rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for equipment, especially tools or apparatus used for a practical activity.

example.english: We’re going hiking soon, so remember to bring all the equipment.
example.traditional: 嚟緊行山，記得帶齊器材。
example.jyutping: lai4 gan2 haang4 saan1 gei3 dak1 daai3 cai4 hei3 coi4

rows.note: Use this for installed or organizational equipment such as office, factory, or venue equipment rather than portable gear.

example.english: All the office equipment has been upgraded.
example.traditional: 辦公室啲設備全部更新咗。
example.jyutping: baan6 gung1 sat1 di1 cit3 bei6 cyun4 bou6 gang1 san1 zo2

rows.note: Use this for a person or group’s gear, especially for travel, hiking, military activities, or expeditions.

example.english: You need to bring enough equipment for camping.
example.jyutping: heoi3 lou6 jing4 jiu3 daai3 zuk1 zong1 bei6

rows.note: Use this when the equipment specifically consists of tools, such as gardening or repair tools.

example.english: This set of equipment is really handy for fixing things.
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 gung1 geoi6 zing2 je5 hou2 hou2 jung6
